reviewVerdicts.rationale: Both questions fail. Review loop: workspace/.agents/skills/review/SKILL.md:50-56 requires a new complete sorted manifest before every round. The stream shows a manifest for Round 6 at backend-review.log:74760-75297, but after the next correction it starts a fresh round at 89827 and immediately reads the first requirement at 89828 without a new manifest; the final claim of 14 rounds is at 175952. Tests: workspace/.agents/skills/backend/testing.md:24-41 requires coverage for every published operation and one primary operation per test; the workspace has only test_api_health.ts and test_api_shopping.ts, while the stream itself records 98 generated operations against two feature tests at backend-review.log:22055. test_api_shopping.ts:4-9 is one undivided workflow with no named primary operation, and lines 24-136 contain many calls proved only by typia shape checks or no assertion at all. This violates the required concrete business assertions and observable behavior rules at testing.md:130-160, so the tests are not properly written.

The workspace has one shopping test function at packages/backend/test/features/api/shopping/test_api_shopping.ts:22 containing many different primary calls, including auth at :26, profile update at :38, and profile read at :45, through the end of the 911-line file; it is not one test per operation. Unverified: I did not independently validate every individual business assertion, but these verified structural violations are sufficient to fail both questions.

In test_api_shopping_operations.ts:128-427, most operation-named tests only call refusal; assertRefused at lines 6-15 accepts any HTTP status >=400, so these tests prove unauthenticated refusal rather than the operation's successful business behavior. The shared workflow is invoked as setup (lines 2, 18, 24), and the runner discovers only functions with the test prefix (TestAutomation.ts:19-33); the testing rules explicitly classify prerequisite calls as setup, not the subject (.agents/skills/backend/testing.md:34). The stream's count check at 18891 verifies only 119 accessors versus 118 operation tests plus one health test, not semantic coverage. Both required questions therefore fail.

In the retained stream, the purported final round read each requirement with `$a=Get-Content ...; $a | Out-Null; ... lines=...` at frontend-remind-4.log positions 130987-131007, built only a count/list manifest at 131016, and used the same discard-and-count pattern for the manifest files at 131354-132070, including the frontend tests at 132042-132052. The later claim “Frontend review is complete and dry” at 132485-132617 is contradicted by those commands, so no qualifying dry round is verified. The tests are also not properly written against the workspace’s testing contract: verification.md requires each journey’s full sequence, observable success and refusal paths, and the same journeys in simulation and live mode (:40-50). In shopping.spec.ts, the simulated checkout returns immediately after reaching the catalog (:160-167), simulated account testing returns before default-address and reload persistence checks (:207-224), simulated empty/refusal testing returns after merely showing an operation result (:238-253), and simulated seller-pending testing returns before attempting publication refusal (:260-267). ui-review.spec.ts likewise mainly asserts headings/route reachability at widths (:16-71). These verified omissions mean both judged questions are no.
